method: Actual ordered release Canvas commands, five native species atlases and four frames per front/back contact. Only the named tree/ore/shore-stone paint texture and transformed origin are allowed to occlude. Contacts use real wildlife movement and heading-dependent ground capsules. Full-world legality and actual repeated approach are reported separately from isolated contacts. Conditional back acceptance requires source-over occlusion wherever opaque source paint actually overlaps. Software Canvas inspection, not native GPU screenshots or manual playthrough.
